description: This file defines the Session class in the OpenCart system, managing session handling including starting, closing, destroying sessions, and garbage collection by interfacing with different session adaptors.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Handles session management including start, close, destroy, and garbage collection for OpenCart.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Session object, loads the specified session adaptor, and registers shutdown functions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a session with a new or existing session ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the current session data from storage.
